title: Magnemite · Fleet
description: Fleet-wide load, memory, storage and temperature, read straight off the hub's database. The charts read DeviceMetricSample; the table reads Device, which is the live row.

target.rawSql: SELECT e.at AS time, CONCAT(d.name, ': ', e.message) AS text, e.signal AS tags FROM `MonitorEvent` e JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = e.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(e.at) AND e.action IS NOT NULL ORDER BY e.at

list.name: group
list.label: Group
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM `DeviceGroup` ORDER BY name

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `online` FROM `Device` d WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND d.status = 'ONLINE' AND d.approved = 1 AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring}))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS `offline` FROM `Device` d WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND d.status <> 'ONLINE' AND d.approved = 1 AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Agent versions
panels.description: More than one means a rollout is half done, or a box is not taking the update.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.agentVersion) AS `versions` FROM `Device` d WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND d.approved = 1 AND d.agentVersion IS NOT NULL AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Monitor actions in this window
panels.description: Events that actually did something to a box — a restart or a reboot. Recoveries and notify-only rules have no action and are not counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS `actions` FROM `MonitorEvent` e JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = e.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(e.at) AND e.action IS NOT NULL AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Load per core
panels.description: loadAvg1 over the core count stored on the sample itself, so a 4-core and an 8-core box are comparable. 1.0 is fully busy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.loadAvg1 / NULLIF(s.cpuCount, 0)) AS `fleet average`, MAX(s.loadAvg1 / NULLIF(s.cpuCount, 0)) AS `worst box` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = s.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(s.at) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal. A box near 100% is about to have the scanner killed.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(100 * (1 - s.memAvailableBytes / NULLIF(s.memTotalBytes, 0))) AS `fleet average`, MAX(100 * (1 - s.memAvailableBytes / NULLIF(s.memTotalBytes, 0))) AS `worst box` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = s.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(s.at) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CPU temperature
panels.description: Null on boxes whose ROM exposes no sensor — a gap here reads 'cannot say', not 'cold'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), AVG(s.cpuTempC) AS `fleet average`, MAX(s.cpuTempC) AS `hottest box` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = s.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(s.at) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Boxes reporting
panels.description: Distinct devices with a sample in each bucket. A step down is boxes going offline; the whole line dropping at once is usually the hub restarting.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(s.at, $__interval), COUNT(DISTINCT s.deviceId) AS `reporting` FROM `DeviceMetricSample` s JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = s.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(s.at) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Boxes now
panels.description: The live Device row, not a sample. Sorted by free storage, because that is what stops an install.

targets.rawSql: SELECT d.name AS `device`, d.status AS `status`, g.name AS `group`, d.agentVersion AS `agent`, ROUND(100 * d.freeBytes / NULLIF(d.totalBytes, 0), 1) AS `free`, d.freeBytes AS `free bytes`, ROUND(d.loadAvg1 / NULLIF(d.cpuCount, 0), 2) AS `load per core`, d.cpuTempC AS `temp`, d.lastSeenAt AS `last seen` FROM `Device` d LEFT JOIN `DeviceGroup` g ON g.id = d.groupId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND d.approved = 1 AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring})) ORDER BY `free` ASC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(e.at, $__interval), e.signal AS metric, COUNT(*) AS `events` FROM `MonitorEvent` e JOIN `Device` d ON d.id = e.deviceId WHERE d.kind = 'BOX' AND $__timeFilter(e.at) AND ('__ALL__' IN (${group:sqlstring}) OR d.groupId IN (${group:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
